blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) has achieved significant progress in Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) by processing short noun phrases to generate segmentation masks with unique instance identifiers. While SAM3 excels at single-concept segmentation, it falls short in complex, real-world environments where multiple concepts must be segmented simultaneously. In particular, SAM3 typically fails to simultaneously process concepts with semantic overlap, leading to semantic misclassifications and redundant mask predictions. Moreover, as the number of concepts increases, the independent inference paradigm introduces prohibitive inference latency. To address these limitations, we propose the Dense Competitive Representations SAM (DCR-SAM) framework. By decoupling cross-modal interactions, the proposed method alleviates the inference latency. To resolve semantic misclassifications, DCR-SAM dynamically aligns textual concepts with visual representations and incorporates a dense competition head to enforce explicit inter-class competition. Furthermore, a learnable background token is applied to absorb non-target objects dynamically. These mechanisms effectively suppress overlapping predictions and generate high-fidelity masks. Extensive experimental evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework: (1) achieves a 2.3% $\sim$ 10.7% performance improvement over state-of-the-art methods, (2) delivers a 33$\times$ inference speedup compared to the native SAM3, and (3) exhibits strong robustness across diverse scenarios.
blocks.zh: 通过处理短名词短语,生成带有独特实例识别符的分块口罩,分块任意模式3(SAM3)在快速概念分块(PCS)方面取得了显著进展. 虽然SAM3在单一概念分割方面表现优异,但在复杂、现实的环境中却不足,必须同时分割多个概念。 特别是,SAM3通常不能同时处理与语义重叠的概念,导致语义错误的分类和多余的面具预测. 此外,随着概念数量的增加,独立的推论范式引入了令人无法忍受的推论延迟. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议采用“DCR-SAM”框架。 通过将跨模式的相互作用脱钩,拟议的方法减轻了推论的延迟性. 为了解决语义上的分类错误,DCR-SAM动态地将文本概念与视觉表达相协调,并纳入一个密集的竞争头,以强制实施明确的阶级间竞争. 此外,还采用可学习的背景标志来动态吸收非目标物体。 这些机制有效地抑制了重叠的预测,并产生了高可靠性的面具. 跨越多个基准的广泛实验性评价表明,拟议框架:(1) 实现2.3%的美元。 与最新方法相比,业绩有10.7%的改进,(2) 与本土的SAM3相比,提供33美元/时间的推论速度,(3) 显示不同情景的强劲性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The evolution of Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) [ 10 , 42 , 49 , 27 , 46 , 9 ] achieved a breakthrough with the Segment Anything Model 3 [ 9 ] (SAM3). As a pioneering architecture in Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) , SAM3 [ 9 ] demonstrates exceptional capability in single-concept segmentation guided by short noun phrases ( e.g. , a red billboard). By incorporating deep cross-modal attention mechanisms, the model leverages textual prompts to dynamically condition visual representations, enabling precise mask generation.
blocks.zh: 视觉基础模型(VFMs)[10,42,49,27,46,9]的演化,与分节任意模式3[9](SAM3)取得了突破. SAM3[9]作为快速概念分解(PCS)的开创性架构,在以短名词短语(例如红色告示牌)为指南的单一概念分解中表现出了特殊的能力。 通过纳入深跨模式的注意机制,该模型利用文字提示来动态地调节视觉表现,从而能够产生精确的面具。

blocks.en:
While SAM3 [ 9 ] excels at single-concept segmentation, complex real-world scenarios [ 31 , 33 , 6 ] ( e.g. , autonomous driving and remote sensing) require simultaneous identification and segmentation of multiple concepts within a single scene. Conventional semantic segmentation methods [ 62 , 11 , 19 , 25 ] achieve multi-class segmentation by assigning individual pixels to a set of predefined classes. However, these methods face limitations in complex environments. They typically rely on narrow, task-specific feature representations and lack broad semantic priors of large-scale foundation models.
On the other hand, SAM3 [ 9 ] leverage robust visual-linguistic representations to achieve remarkable performance in single-concept segmentation. However, it faces two critical challenges when extended to multi-class scenarios: ❶ SAM3 typically fails to simultaneously process similar concepts, leading to semantic misclassifications and redundant mask predictions. ❷ As the number of target concepts increases, the original SAM3 inference paradigm incurs exceptionally high inference latency.
blocks.zh:
虽然SAM3[9]在单一概念分割方面表现优异,但复杂的现实世界情景[31、33、6](如自主驱动和遥感)要求在同一场景中同时识别和分割多个概念。 常规语义分解方法[62,11,19,25]通过将单个像素分配到一组预定义的类实现多级分解. 然而,这些方法在复杂的环境中面临局限性。 它们通常依赖狭义的,任务特有的特征表现,缺乏大规模基础模型的广义语义前传.
另一方面,SAM3[9]利用强势的视觉语言表现,实现单概念分化的显著性能. 然而,在扩展至多类情景时,它面临着两个关键的挑战:QQ SAM3通常未能同时处理类似的概念,导致语义错误的分类和多余的面具预测. ❷ 随着目标概念数量的增加,最初的SAM3推论范式产生了异常高的推论延迟.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Comparison of inference latency. The inference latency of the original SAM3 increases linearly 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ) \mathcal{O}(n) with the number of categories, whereas our method achieves a 33x speedup.

blocks.en: Recent works [ 31 , 14 ] achieve multi-class segmentation by aggregating the individual masks independently predicted by SAM3 for multiple categories. However, this paradigm inherently treats the multi-class segmentation as a series of independent binary segmentation tasks. Consequently, there is a complete absence of competition among categories, which leaves the model without explicit constraints to differentiate semantically similar concepts. As shown in Figure 2 , the model frequently produces “double-high” activations for identical pixel regions when processing similar concepts ( e.g. , tree vs. plant). This unconstrained behavior inevitably leads to semantic misclassifications and overlapping masks, severely degrading the reliability of the dense prediction results.
blocks.zh: 近期的作品[31,14]通过汇总SAM3独立预测的多个类别的单个口罩,实现了多级分割. 然而,这个范式内在地将多级分化视为一系列独立的二元分化任务. 因此,各类别之间完全不存在竞争,使模式没有明显的限制来区分形形色色相似的概念。 如图2所示,该模型在处理类似概念(例如树对植物)时,经常为相同的像素区域产生“双高”激活。 这种不受约束的行为不可避免地导致语义错误的分类和重叠的面具,严重地降低了密集预测结果的可靠性.

blocks.en: On the other hand, the standard architecture of SAM3 requires executing independent and computationally expensive cross-attention operations for each concept to acquire concept-specific dense visual features, followed by an independent decoding process. As shown in Figure 2 , our inference latency scaling analysis reveals that on the ADE20K [ 70 ] dataset with 150 categories, the inference time scales linearly ( 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ) \mathcal{O}(n) ) as the number of categories increases, ultimately resulting in severe inference latency.
blocks.zh: 另一方面,SAM3的标准架构需要针对每个概念执行独立且计算成本昂贵的交叉意向操作,以获得特定概念的密集视觉特征,然后是独立的解码过程. 如图2所示,我们的推论纬度缩放分析显示,在ADE20K [70] 有150个类别的数据集中,推论时间尺度是线性(O ⁡(n)\mathcal{O}(n))随着类别数量的增加,最终导致严重的推论纬度.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose the D ense C ompetitive R epresentations SAM ( DCR-SAM ) framework, which adapts SAM3 into an efficient architecture for multi-class segmentation. Specifically, the proposed framework resolves the aforementioned challenges through three key designs: ❶ To overcome the 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ) \mathcal{O}(n) inference latency, we decouple the deep cross-modal interactions by replacing class-specific text queries with a unified learnable prompt sequence. This approach enables the extraction of a globally contextualized visual representation shared across all concepts through a single forward pass, achieving a nearly 33 × \times inference speedup compared to the native SAM3, as shown in Figure 2 . ❷ To resolve semantic misclassifications among similar concepts, we transition from isolated decoding to a dense competitive paradigm through the introduction of the Vision-Conditioned Text Refinement (VCTR) and Vision-Guided Text Pooling (VGTP) modules, coupled with a dense competition head. VCTR explicitly aligns textual sequence with the modified visual representation by injecting image-specific visual cues, whereas VGTP dynamically compresses this aligned sequence into highly discriminative global class anchors. By enforcing explicit inter-class competition, the proposed method effectively alleviates “double-high” activations and generates high-fidelity masks. ❸ Furthermore, to enhance adaptability across diverse unconstrained scenarios, we incorporate a dynamically learnable background token to absorb non-target objects adaptively.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出了Dense Copetitive R epositions SAM(DCR-SAM)框架,该框架将SAM3改造为多级分割的有效架构. 具体而言,拟议框架通过三项关键设计解决上述挑战: 为了克服 O QQ (n)\ mathcal{O}(n) 推论的延迟性,我们用一个统一的可学习的快速序列来取代特定类的文本查询来解析深层的跨模式交互. 如图2所示,通过这一办法,能够通过单一的前进通道提取出所有概念共享的具有全球背景的视觉表现,与本地的SAM3相比,实现近33xxxxx时间的推论速度。 为了解决类似概念之间的语义分类错误,我们通过引入"视觉条件文字精准化"(VCTR)和"视觉指导文字集合"(VGTP)模块,加上密集的竞争头,从孤立的解码向密集的竞争范式过渡. VCTR通过注入图像特定视觉提示,明确将文字序列与修改后的视觉表达方式对齐,而VGTP则动态地将这种对齐序列压缩成极具歧视性的全球类锚. 通过实施明确的阶级间竞争,拟议的方法有效地缓解了“双高”激活,并产生了高纯度的面具。 此外,为了提高各种不受限制的情景的适应性,我们采用了动态可学习的背景标志,以适应性地吸收非目标物体。

blocks.en: The main contributions of our work are summarized as follows: • We reveal how the independent inference paradigm of SAM3 induces severe semantic misclassification among conceptually similar categories and results in an 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ) \mathcal{O}(n) inference latency. • We propose DCR-SAM , by decoupling cross-modal interactions to alleviate inference latency and dynamically aligning textual concepts with visual representation, the proposed method effectively suppresses overlapping predictions to generate high-fidelity masks. • Extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across multiple domain benchmarks while exhibiting excellent inference efficiency.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) [ 27 , 46 , 9 ] represents a significant milestone for promptable segmentation models, demonstrating remarkable cross-domain generalization across diverse downstream applications [ 31 , 3 , 54 , 41 , 6 , 33 ] . Central to this success is the Promptable Visual Segmentation (PVS) paradigm introduced by SAM [ 27 ] and SAM 2 [ 46 ] , where visual prompts ( e.g. , points, boxes, or masks) guide the segmentation of specific targets. Driven by large-scale, high-quality datasets, this paradigm establishes a robust baseline for generalized segmentation. Building upon this foundation, SAM3 [ 9 ] extends the architecture from PVS to Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) , enabling the model to segment all instances of a given concept using short noun phrases ( e.g. , a red billboard). Recent studies [ 30 , 44 , 64 , 63 , 13 ] explore improvements to this architecture. For example, EfficientSAM3 [ 64 , 63 ] enhances the overall inference efficiency of SAM3 through distillation, SAM3-Adapter [ 13 ] injects prior heuristic information for downstream tasks via a lightweight staged adapter. However, these works fundamentally retain the inherent serial inference mechanism of the native architecture. Consequently, they incur non-negligible inference latency and semantic misclassification when applied to real-world multi-class segmentation tasks. Meanwhile CoCo-SAM3 [ 14 ] proposes a training-free framework that separates the inference process into intra-class enhancement and inter-class competition modules to alleviate semantic misclassification. Nevertheless, this method relies heavily on complex score calibration and multi-prompt encoding. In this work, we alleviate these issues at the architectural level by decoupling cross-modal interactions. Furthermore, by dynamically aligning textual anchors with visual representations and introducing explicit inter-class competition, the proposed framework effectively mitigates semantic misclassification and generates high-fidelity masks.
blocks.zh: 分块任何物模型[SAM][27,46,9]是快速分块模型的一个重要里程碑,显示出不同下游应用的显著跨域概括[31,3,54,41,6,33]. 这一成功的关键是SAM[27]和SAM [46]提出的快速视觉分裂(PVS)范式,其中视觉提示(如点,盒,或口罩)指导特定目标的分裂. 在大规模高质量数据集的推动下,这一范式为普遍分化建立了坚实的基线. 在这个基础上,SAM3[9]将架构从PVS扩展至可快速概念分割(PCS),使模型能够使用短名词短语(如红色告示牌)将特定概念的所有实例分割开来. 最近的研究[30、44、64、63、13]探讨了这一架构的改进。 例如,高效SAM3[64,63]通过蒸馏增强SAM3的总体推导效率,SAM3-Adapter[13]通过轻量级的舞台适配器为下游任务注入前热度信息. 然而,这些作品从根本上保留了本土建筑固有的连环推断机制. 因此,当适用于现实世界的多类分化任务时,它们会引起不可忽略的推论性定律和语义错误分类。 同时CoCo-SAM3[14]提出无培训框架,将推论过程分为班内增强和班际竞争模块,以缓解语义错误分类. 尽管如此,这种方法仍然严重依赖复杂的分数校准和多时速编码. 在这项工作中,我们通过将跨模式互动脱钩,在建筑层面缓解这些问题。 此外,拟议框架通过动态地将文字主锚与视觉表现一致,并引入明确的阶级间竞争,有效地减轻语义上的错分类,并产生高诚信的面具。

blocks.en: Multi-class semantic segmentation is a fundamental task in computer vision, with the objective of assigning a specific semantic label to every pixel within an image. The field has witnessed remarkable progress, evolving from early CNN-based models, such as FCN [ 35 ] and U-Net [ 47 ] , to modern Transformer-based architectures, such as SegFormer [ 61 ] , Mask2Former [ 15 ] and EoMT [ 25 ] . While these methods excel at efficient dense prediction, they typically rely on narrow, task-specific feature representations, thereby lacking the broad semantic priors inherent in large-scale foundation models. Several vision-language models, such as CLIP [ 45 ] , SigLIP [ 65 ] , and ALIGN [ 24 ] , emphasize global image-text alignment and inherently lack pixel-level granularity, rendering them unsuitable for direct application to downstream dense prediction tasks. Conversely, self-supervised vision foundation models, such as DINO [ 10 , 42 , 49 ] , capture excellent fine-grained pixel-level representations on massive image corpora, yet they lack explicit cross-modal semantic guidance and require the training of task-specific decoder heads for multi-class segmentation. In this work, we fully leverage the powerful cross-modal priors of SAM3 [ 9 ] to enhance the potential of the model in dense prediction tasks.
blocks.zh: 多级语义分解是计算机视觉中的一项基本任务,目标是为图像中的每一个像素指定特定的语义标签. 该领域取得了显著进展,从早期基于CNN的模型,如FCN[35]和U-Net[47],发展到现代基于变形器的建筑,如SegFormer[61],Mask2Former[15]和EOMT[25]. 虽然这些方法在高效的密集预测方面非常出色,但它们通常依赖狭隘的、针对具体任务的特征表述,因此缺乏大规模基础模型所固有的广义语义前缀。 CLIP[45],SigLIP[65],以及ALIGN[24]等几种视觉语言模型强调全球图像文本对齐,本质上缺乏像素级颗粒性,使其不适合直接应用于下游密集的预测任务. 反之,自我监督的视觉基础模型,如DINO[10,42,49],捕捉到在巨型图像corpora上的出色精细的像素级表现,然而它们缺乏明确的跨模式语义指导,需要训练任务特定的解码头进行多级分解. 在这项工作中,我们充分利用SAM3[9]的强大的跨模式前传,增强模型在密集预测任务中的潜力.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we first briefly review the Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) pipeline of SAM3 ( § 3.1 ). Subsequently, we elaborate on the overall architecture of our proposed DCR-SAM framework ( § 3.2 ). The overview of our method is illustrated in Figure 3 . Finally, we introduce the joint optimization and the corresponding objective functions ( § 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先简要回顾SAM3(第3.1节)的快速概念分割管道。 随后,我们阐述了我们提议的DCR-SAM框架的总体结构(第3.2节)。 图3概述了我们的方法。 最后,我们提出联合优化和相应的客观功能(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Overview of our proposed DCR-SAM framework. It transforms SAM3 from an independent decoding paradigm to a dense competitive paradigm. First, we alleviate the inference latency via Decoupled Visual Conditioning to obtain a globally contextualized visual representation. Then, we align text and visual features using the VCTR and VGTP modules. Finally, we design a competition head to enforce explicit inter-class competition and generate high-fidelity masks.
blocks.zh: 图3:我们提议的DCR-SAM框架概述。 它将SAM3从独立的解码范式转变为密集的竞争范式. 首先,我们通过脱钩的视觉条件来缓解推论的延迟性,以获得全球背景化的视觉表现。 然后,我们利用VCTR和VGTP模块来调整文本和视觉功能. 最后,我们设计了一个竞争主管,以执行明确的阶级间竞争,并产生高忠诚度的面具.

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminary
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: Unlike dual-encoder architectures such as CLIP [ 45 ] , SAM3 [ 9 ] employs an encoder-decoder architecture where the core modules comprise the vision encoder, the text encoder, the fusion encoder, and the semantic decoding head (for simplicity, we exclusively discuss the modules relevant to this work). Given an input image I ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 I\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} and a target concept set comprising N N categories C = { c 1 , c 2 , … , c N } C=\{c_{1},c_{2},\dots,c_{N}\} , the network initially processes the image through a vision encoder to extract the unconditioned visual embeddings 𝒱 ∈ ℝ h ​ w × d \mathcal{V}\in\mathbb{R}^{hw\times d} , where d d denotes the embedding dimension, h h and w w depend on the patch resolution of the vision encoder. Simultaneously, each specific concept c i c_{i} is encoded into prompt tokens p i ∈ ℝ l × d p_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{l\times d} via a text encoder, where l l denotes the sequence length. The complete set of prompt tokens is denoted as 𝒫 = { p 1 , p 2 , … , p N } \mathcal{P}=\{p_{1},p_{2},\dots,p_{N}\} . Subsequently, to achieve concept-specific localization, the unconditioned visual embeddings must be dynamically conditioned on the prompt tokens. Following the native architecture of SAM3 [ 9 ] , a fusion encoder E f ​ u ​ s ​ i ​ o ​ n E_{fusion} accepts the unconditioned visual embeddings 𝒱 \mathcal{V} and conditions these embeddings on the prompt tokens p i p_{i} using a stack of Transformer [ 55 ] blocks equipped with self-attention and cross-attention layers. The output of fusion encoder constitutes the conditioned visual embeddings: 𝒱 c ​ o ​ n ​ d i = E f ​ u ​ s ​ i ​ o ​ n ​ ( 𝒱 , p i ) , 𝒱 c ​ o ​ n ​ d i ∈ ℝ h ​ w × d . \mathcal{V}_{cond}^{i}=E_{fusion}(\mathcal{V},p_{i}),\quad\mathcal{V}_{cond}^{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{hw\times d}. (1) Finally, these conditioned embeddings are fed into a semantic decoding head, which is adapted from the MaskFormer [ 16 ] architecture, to decode the binary semantic logits map ℳ i \mathcal{M}_{i} for the specific concept c i c_{i} : ℳ i = SegHead ⁡ ( V c ​ o ​ n ​ d i ) , ℳ i ∈ ℝ h × w . \mathcal{M}_{i}=\mathrm{SegHead}(V_{cond}^{i}),\quad\mathcal{M}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w}. (2) In a dense multi-class scenario, to obtain the comprehensive multi-class prediction ℳ \mathcal{M} , the independently generated binary semantic logit maps must first be aggregated. blocks.en: This pipeline must execute the feature fusion and decoding processes independently for each category, which introduces a inference latency with a complexity of 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ) \mathcal{O}(n) . Furthermore, the independent prediction paradigm for each category inherently lacks inter-class competition, thereby provoking severe semantic misclassifications and overlapping masks. In contrast, by decoupling the cross-modal fusion process and constructing a dense competition head, our method transforms the native serial binary segmenter into a highly efficient competitive multi-class architecture.

Instead of repeatedly feeding the specific text prompt p i p_{i} into the computationally intensive fusion encoder ( cf. Eq. 1 ), we introduce a unified learnable prompt sequence p ∗ ∈ ℝ l × d p^{*}\in\mathbb{R}^{l\times d} . By substituting the concept-specific tokens with p ∗ p^{*} , We completely decouple the deep cross-modal feature fusion from specific prompt tokens. Consequently, the fusion encoder integrates the visual features with the unified prompt sequence through a single forward pass, yielding the joint representation 𝒱 ∗ \mathcal{V}^{*} : 𝒱 ∗ = E f ​ u ​ s ​ i ​ o ​ n ​ ( 𝒱 , p ∗ ) , 𝒱 ∗ ∈ ℝ h ​ w × d . \mathcal{V}^{*}=E_{fusion}(\mathcal{V},p^{*}),\quad\mathcal{V}^{*}\in\mathbb{R}^{hw\times d}. Benefiting from this strictly category-agnostic feature fusion process, our approach fundamentally alleviates the inherent inference latency bottleneck of the native architecture.

blocks.en: The native SAM3 [ 9 ] independent inference paradigm lacks inter-class competition, leading to severe semantic misclassification and overlapping masks among conceptually similar categories. To fundamentally resolve this issue, our DCR-SAM framework shifts from isolated decoding to a dense competitive paradigm, where textual features are explicitly aligned with globally contextualized visual representations to ensure robust cross-modal grounding. However, original textual features extracted by the text encoder are static and context-free, rendering direct alignment suboptimal. Therefore, we propose the Vision-Conditioned Text Refinement (VCTR) module, which achieves dynamic alignment by integrating image-specific visual cues into textual features. Specifically, we design a lightweight Cross-Attention (CA) module to refine the text representations. The text tokens p i p_{i} for each category serve as the Query ( Q Q ), while the globally contextualized visual features 𝒱 ∗ \mathcal{V}^{*} act as the Key ( K K ) and Value ( V V ). Finally, we aggregate all category features to obtain the aligned textual feature set 𝒫 ~ = { p ~ 1 , p ~ 2 , … , p ~ N } \mathcal{\widetilde{P}}=\{\tilde{p}_{1},\tilde{p}_{2},\dots,\tilde{p}_{N}\} : p ~ i = MHA ⁡ ( LN ⁡ ( p i ) , LN ⁡ ( 𝒱 ∗ ) , LN ⁡ ( 𝒱 ∗ ) ) + p i , where ​ p ~ i ∈ ℝ l × d , 𝒫 ~ ∈ ℝ N × l × d . \tilde{p}_{i}=\mathrm{MHA}(\mathrm{LN}(p_{i}),\mathrm{LN}(\mathcal{V}^{*}),\mathrm{LN}(\mathcal{V}^{*}))+p_{i},\quad\mathrm{where}\,\,\tilde{p}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{l\times d},\,\,\mathcal{\widetilde{P}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times l\times d}. Notably, this lightweight module involves only simple matrix operations and a minimal number of additional parameters, incurring a negligible inference latency.

blocks.en: In multi-class segmentation tasks, pixels not belonging to predefined target categories are typically assigned to a background class. To adapt the SAM3 [ 9 ] to this formulation, a straightforward solution uses a generic text prompt, e.g. , background. However, this concept is overly broad and lacks explicit visual grounding. Alternatively, hard-coding background categories ( e.g. , sky or cloud) severely degrades architectural universality, requires extensive dataset-specific engineering, and fails to exhaust all potential unknown distractors. To address these limitations, we introduce an independent, learnable background token 𝒯 b ​ g ∈ ℝ 1 × d \mathcal{T}_{bg}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times d} and concatenate it with the generated text anchors to form a complete semantic anchor set 𝒯 \mathcal{T} : 𝒯 = Concat ⁡ ( 𝒯 a ​ n ​ c ​ h ​ o ​ r , 𝒯 b ​ g ) , 𝒯 ∈ ℝ ( N + 1 ) × d . \mathcal{T}=\mathrm{Concat}(\mathcal{T}_{anchor},\mathcal{T}_{bg}),\quad\mathcal{T}\in\mathbb{R}^{(N+1)\times d}. blocks.en: We evaluate our DCR-SAM on four highly challenging natural-scene benchmarks: ADE20K [ 70 ] , which encompasses a dense label space of 150 classes, Cityscapes [ 17 ] , which contains 19 classes tailored for urban driving scenarios, COCO-Stuff-164K [ 7 ] ( COCO-Stuff ), which features a vast and diverse label space of 171 classes, and PASCAL-Context59 [ 40 ] ( Context59 ), which provides dense annotations for 59 prevalent categories. To demonstrate cross-domain robustness, we extend our evaluation to four representative remote sensing benchmarks: LoveDA [ 56 ] with 7 classes, ISPRS Potsdam [ 48 ] with 6 classes, ISPRS Vaihingen [ 39 ] with 6 classes, and iSAID [ 58 ] with 16 classes. Unless stated otherwise, all models are trained on their respective training sets, and the results are reported on the official validation sets. We employ the standard mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) as our primary metric.
blocks.zh: 我们根据四个极具挑战性的自然环境基准来评估我们的DCR-SAM:ADE20K[70],它包含150个等级的密集标签空间;Cityscapes[17],它包含19个适合城市驾驶情景的类别;COCO-Stuff-164K[7](COCO-Stuff),它具有171个等级的广阔和多样的标签空间;PASAL-Context59[40](背景59),它为59个流行类别提供了密集的说明。 为了显示跨领域稳健性,我们的评价扩大到四个有代表性的遥感基准:LoveDA[56]分7个班,ISPRS波茨坦[48]分6个班,ISPRS Vaihingen[39]分6个班,以及iSAID[58]分16个班。 除非另有说明,否则所有模型都接受各自培训组合的培训,结果在正式验证组合中报告。 我们使用标准平均跨联盟(mIoU)作为主要衡量标准。

blocks.en: We compare DCR-SAM with state-of-the-art semantic segmentation methods, including InternImage-H [ 57 ] , EoMT [ 25 ] , and SegMAN-L [ 19 ] . For SAM3 [ 9 ] , we adopt its complete official architecture, retaining all core components, including the detector and presence prediction modules, and establish two baselines: ➀ Native-Binary ( SAM3 † ), which follows the official training strategy to independently predict binary masks for each category; and ➁ Native-Multi-Class ( SAM3 ‡ ), which concatenates category-wise predictions and is fine-tuned under a standard multi-class training paradigm. Following established SAM3 adaptation practices, semantic masks from both the semantic and detector heads are fused to obtain the final segmentation results. Notably, the latter configuration lacks explicit inter-class competition, potentially leading to semantic overlap among related categories.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了DCR-SAM与最先进的语义分解方法,包括InternImage-H [57],EOMT [25],和SegMAN-L [19]。 对于SAM3 [9],我们采用了完整的官方架构,保留所有核心组件,包括探测器和存在预测模块,并设定两个基线:遵循官方培训策略,独立预测每个类别的二元口罩;以及QQE土著-多级(SAM3 QQ),该结构将分类预测与多级标准培训范式相结合,并进行了微调。 按照既定的SAM3适应做法,将语义头和探测头的语义口罩引信,以获得最后的分解结果。 值得注意的是,后一种配置缺乏明确的阶级间竞争,可能导致相关类别之间的语义重叠。

blocks.en: 4.2 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 4.2 总体业绩

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , our method demonstrates exceptional performance across various benchmarks. In natural scene datasets, the proposed method significantly outperforms previous SOTA approaches, yielding substantial improvements ranging from 2.3% ∼ \sim 8.4% . Even compared with InternImage-H [ 57 ] , a vision foundation model built upon deformable convolutions, our method consistently achieves superior results. In cross-domain remote sensing scenarios, it continues to demonstrate substantial superiority, achieving improvements of approximately 2.4% ∼ \sim 10.7% . Furthermore, it significantly surpasses specialized methods designed for remote sensing, such as LOGCAN++ [ 38 ] and SCSM [ 37 ] , verifying its robust scene adaptability. Notably, the performance gains achieved in remote sensing are generally more pronounced than those in natural scenes. We attribute this phenomenon to the significantly smaller concept space of remote sensing imagery compared to natural scenes, enabling the dense competition head to establish more stable semantic anchors.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,我们的方法显示不同基准的出色表现。 在自然场景数据集中,拟议方法大大超过了以往的SOTA方法,取得了2.3% \sim 8.4%。 即使与InternImage-H[57]相比,一个建立在可变形的演化基础上的愿景基础模型,我们的方法始终取得了优异的结果. 在跨域遥感设想中,它继续表现出巨大的优势,取得了大约2.4%的改进,即10.7%。 此外,它还大大超过了为遥感设计的专门方法,例如LOGCAN++[38]和SCSM[37],以验证其强健的场景适应性。 值得注意的是,与自然场景相比,遥感方面所取得的性能收益一般更为明显。 我们将此现象归因于与自然场景相比,遥感图像的概念空间要小得多,使得密集的竞争头能够建立更稳定的语义锚.

blocks.en: Moreover, the comparison with the two SAM3 adaptation baselines demonstrates that both training paradigms fail to achieve optimal results without modifying the core network architecture. Notably, the performance of the Native-Multi-Class paradigm (SAM3 ‡ ) is inferior to that of the original Native-Binary paradigm (SAM3 † ). This performance degradation indicates that merely adjusting the training strategy fails to compensate for the inherent architectural defects of the model in multi-class segmentation tasks. More experimental analysis in the Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 此外,与SAM3两个适应基线的比较表明,两种培训模式都未能在不修改核心网络结构的情况下取得最佳结果。 值得注意的是,土著-多阶层范式(SAM3 )的表现低于原始土著-基准范式(SAM3 )的表现。 这种性能退化表明,仅仅调整培训策略无法弥补该模型在多级分解任务中固有的建筑缺陷. 附录B.1中更多的实验分析。

blocks.en: We visualize the segmentation results across both natural scene and remote sensing benchmarks in Figure 4 . SAM3 exhibits limitations such as semantic fragmentation, noisy artifacts ( e.g. , on the person in Context59), and regional misclassifications ( e.g. , omitting vegetation in LoveDA) in complex semantic contexts. Conversely, our DCR-SAM preserves the high-fidelity spatial delineation inherent to SAM3 while demonstrating significant improvements in semantic discriminability.

blocks.zh: 4.3 进一步分析

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness of the proposed modules, we conduct an ablation analysis on the ADE20K and LoveDA benchmarks. Table 2 reports the per-image inference time (ms) and the mIoU on both benchmarks. The proposed method achieves a 33 × \times inference speedup on the ADE20K benchmark, decreasing the inference time from 8038 ms to 244 ms alongside substantial performance gains, which demonstrates the necessity of decoupling the cross-modal feature fusion. Furthermore, the text refinement results indicate that incorporating the VCTR module yields significant improvements with only a marginal increase in inference latency, extending the inference time from 224 ms to 244 ms on the ADE20K dataset. Regarding the pooling strategy, the proposed VGTP module significantly outperforms conventional approaches such as first, last, and mean pooling, confirming that dynamic compression constructs highly discriminative textual anchors. For the background category, it can be observed that the proposed dynamic background strategy ( 𝒯 b ​ g \mathcal{T}_{bg} ) achieves optimal performance. Although expanding the number of hard-coding background categories can further improve the performance, this strategy requires extensive prompt engineering and manual adaptations specific to the dataset, thereby significantly limiting the general applicability of the model. Additional ablation analyses are detailed in Appendix B.1 .

The performance variations exhibit a highly consistent trend across all four evaluation benchmarks, uniformly achieving optimal results when l l is set to 32. blocks.en: We further compare DCR-SAM with four recent SAM 3-based methods, including SegEarth-OV3 [ 31 ] , CoCo-SAM3 [ 14 ] , EfficientSAM3 [ 64 ] , and SAM3-Adapter [ 13 ] . As shown in Table 5 , DCR-SAM consistently outperforms these methods, achieving 68.7% mIoU on ADE20K and 66.5% mIoU on LoveDA, surpassing the strongest baselines by 21.5% and 13.6%, respectively. While SegEarth-OV3 and CoCo-SAM3 adopt training-free strategies, EfficientSAM3 and SAM3-Adapter primarily focus on efficient adaptation without explicitly addressing inter-class semantic conflicts. In contrast, DCR-SAM introduces a dense competitive head to enforce explicit inter-class competition, effectively mitigating semantic overlap and improving multi-class segmentation performance.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将DCR-SAM与最近基于SAM的四种方法进行比较,包括SegEarth-OV3 [31],CoCo-SAM3 [14],高效SAM3 [64],以及SAM3-Adapter [13]. 如表5所示,DCR-SAM的绩效始终高于这些方法,在ADE20K上达到68.7%的MIOU,在LoveDA上达到66.5%的MIOU,分别超过最强基线的21.5%和13.6%. 虽然SegEarth-OV3和Co-SAM3采用无培训战略,但高效SAM3和SAM3-Adapter主要侧重于高效的适应,而没有明确处理阶级语义冲突。 相比之下,DCR-SAM引入了密集的竞争头来强制实施明确的阶级间竞争,有效缓解语义重叠,提高多阶级分化性能.

blocks.en: To isolate the contribution of our segmentation architecture, we further compare DCR-SAM with representative segmentation heads, including UPerNet [ 60 ] , Mask2Former [ 15 ] , and EoMT-Style [ 25 ] , using the same PE-L+/14 backbone [ 4 ] . As shown in Table 5 , DCR-SAM achieves 68.7 mIoU on ADE20K, outperforming UPerNet, EoMT-Style, and Mask2Former by 9.1%, 16.6%, and 7.4%, respectively. These results demonstrate that the performance gains are not solely attributable to the backbone, but also benefit from our proposed dense competitive architecture. Notably, the PE backbone is specifically optimized for open-vocabulary tasks, making it less suitable for conventional closed-set segmentation heads. By preserving the native promptable architecture of SAM 3 and introducing explicit inter-class competition, DCR-SAM better exploits its pre-trained cross-modal representations for dense multi-class segmentation.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离我们分块结构的贡献,我们进一步比较了DCR-SAM与代表性分块头,包括UPerNet [60],Mask2Former [15],以及EOMT-Style [25],使用相同的PE-L+/14主干线[4]. 如表5所示,DCR-SAM在ADE20K上实现68.7 mIoU,表现优于UPerNet,EOMT-Style,和Mask2Former,分别为9.1%,16.6%和7.4%。 这些结果表明,业绩收益不仅可归因于骨干部门,而且还受益于我们提议的密集竞争结构。 值得注意的是,PE主干部分被具体优化用于开放的省道任务,使其更不适合常规的闭塞设置分头. 通过保留SAM 3的本土快速结构,并引入明确的班级间竞争,DCR-SAM更好地利用其经过预先培训的跨模式代表,进行密集的多班分化.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose the D ense C ompetitive R epresentations SAM ( DCR-SAM ) framework to mitigate the inference latency and inherent semantic misclassifications encountered during the adaptation of SAM3 to multi-class segmentation. The proposed method decouples the feature fusion process to ensure optimal inference efficiency. Furthermore, the alignment of textual and visual representations within a dense competitive paradigm effectively suppresses overlapping predictions among conceptually similar categories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the framework achieves SOTA performance across diverse benchmarks while delivering a 33 × \times speedup. We hope our work paves the way for adapting foundation models to complex, real-world multi-class segmentation tasks.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了Dense Copetitive R electionations SAM(DCR-SAM)框架,以减轻在SAM3适应多级分化过程中遇到的推论性定律和固有语义错误分类. 拟议的方法将特征聚变过程脱钩,以确保最佳推论效率. 此外,在密集的竞争范式中调整文字和视觉表述,有效地抑制了概念上相似类别之间的重叠预测。 广泛的实验表明,该框架实现了跨不同基准的SOTA性能,同时实现了33×\时速的加速. 我们希望,我们的工作为使基础模式适应复杂的、现实世界的多阶级划分任务铺平道路。

blocks.en: DCR-SAM reduces text prompt sensitivity and inference latency, facilitating its potential application in autonomous systems and medical imaging. However, its reliance on large-scale foundation models incurs substantial computational costs and may inherit biases from pre-training data. Moreover, inter-class competition may impair the recognition of unseen concepts. Future work will focus on improving computational efficiency and generalization in open-vocabulary segmentation.
blocks.zh: DCR-SAM降低文本的即时敏感性和推论延迟性,促进其潜在应用于自主系统和医学成像. 然而,对大规模基础模型的依赖需要大量的计算费用,并可能继承培训前数据的偏见。 此外,阶级之间的竞争可能损害对无形概念的承认。 今后的工作将侧重于提高公开投票分区的计算效率和一般化。

blocks.en: A.1 Detailed Implementation Setup
blocks.zh: A.1 详细的执行设置

blocks.en: During the training phase, we strictly adhere to the data processing protocols established for the SAM3 [ 9 ] model. To maintain batch consistency across varying image scales, all input images are randomly resized to dimensions within the range of 480 to 1008 pixels utilizing a stride of 32, and subsequently padded to a unified spatial resolution of 1008 × 1008 1008\times 1008 . In addition, standard data augmentation techniques, including random horizontal flipping and color jittering, are uniformly applied. During the inference phase, all images are processed using the standard 1008 × 1008 1008\times 1008 input resolution natively required by the SAM3 architecture. Furthermore, to ensure fairness in the evaluation, all experimental results are derived directly from the raw outputs of the model without the application of any post-processing techniques ( e.g. , PAMR [ 1 ] or DenseCRF [ 29 ] ).
blocks.zh: 在培训阶段,我们严格遵守为SAM3[9]模式制定的数据处理协议。 为了保持不同图像尺度的批量一致性,所有输入图像都随机调整到480至1008像素范围内的维度,使用32步,然后加入1008×1008 1008\times 1008的统一空间分辨率. 此外,标准数据增强技术,包括随机水平翻转和彩色抖动,也被统一应用. 在推导阶段,所有图像都使用标准1008×10081008\times1008输入分辨率进行处理,这是SAM3架构本土要求的. 此外,为确保评价的公正性,所有实验结果都直接来自模型的原始产出,而没有应用任何后处理技术(例如PAMR[1]或DenseCRF[29])。

blocks.en: For a fair and rigorous evaluation of inference efficiency as reported in Figure 2 and Table 2 , all inference latency measurements are conducted on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU. We report the per-image processing time configured with a batch size of 1. To eliminate hardware initialization and memory allocation overhead, we perform 50 warm-up iterations prior to measurement, and the final latency is calculated as the average execution time of the subsequent forward passes.
blocks.zh: 如图2和表2所示,为了公平和严格地评价推论效率,所有推论延迟度测量都是在单一的NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU上进行的. 我们报告每个图像的处理时间配置为批量尺寸为1。 为消除硬件初始化和内存分配的间接费用,我们在计量前进行50次热力迭代,最后的耐久性作为后续远期通行证的平均执行时间计算.

blocks.en: To thoroughly evaluate our method, we fine-tune the pre-trained SAM3 model under two distinct paradigms. As shown in Figure 7 , for both baselines, the image encoder and the text encoder are strictly frozen to preserve broad generic priors, while only the fusion encoder and the segmentation heads are fully optimized. For foreground categories, we directly utilize the original class names provided by the dataset, whereas a generic text prompt, i.e. , “background”, is employed to represent the background category. The detailed settings are as follows:
blocks.zh: 为了彻底评价我们的方法,我们在两个不同的范式下微调了预先训练的SAM3模型. 如图7所示,对于这两个基线,图像编码器和文本编码器都被严格冻结,以保留广义的通用前缀,而只有聚变编码器和分解头被完全优化. 展望类别,我们直接使用数据集提供的原始类名称,而使用通用文本即“背景”来代表背景类别。 详细设置如下:

blocks.en: I ) Native-Binary ( SAM3 † ): This baseline strictly adheres to the official strategy of SAM3. The fusion encoder processes each text prompt independently in a serial 𝒪 ⁡ ( n ) \mathcal{O}(n) manner. The model is optimized using isolated binary prediction heads, supervised by a combination of the binary cross-entropy loss, dice loss, and presence loss for each individual concept. To construct the training data for this binary paradigm, we decouple the dense ground-truth annotations into independent binary masks based on the target categories present in the current image. Furthermore, we randomly introduce negative samples ( i.e. , unrepresented categories with completely empty ground-truth masks) during training to enhance the model’s semantic discriminability and effectively suppress false positive predictions.
blocks.zh: (一) 土著-渔业(SAM3) 这个基线严格遵守SAM3的官方战略. 聚变编码器以序列 O \\\ (n)\ mathcal{O}(n) 方式独立处理每个文本 。 该模型使用孤立的二进制预测头进行优化,由二进制交叉切换损失,骰子损失,以及每个单个概念的存在损失等组合监督. 为了构建这一二进制范式的训练数据,我们根据当前图像中的目标类别,将密集的地面真实说明解为独立的二进制面具. 此外,我们在培训期间随机引入负面样本(即完全空空的地面真假面具无人代理类别),以加强模型的语义歧视性,并有效压制虚假的阳性预测。

blocks.en: II ) Native-Multi-Class ( SAM3 ‡ ): To adapt the native SAM3 architecture for a conventional multi-class setting, we concatenate the independently generated logits along the category dimension. A standard 𝚜𝚘𝚏𝚝𝚖𝚊𝚡 \mathtt{softmax} activation is then applied to explicitly calibrate probabilities across the N N classes, followed by optimization via the cross-entropy loss and dice loss. To prevent Out-of-Memory (OOM) errors caused by processing an excessive number of categories simultaneously, we employ a dynamic prompt sampling strategy during training: we sample all ground-truth categories present in the current scene alongside a dynamically varying number of negative categories, ensuring a stable memory footprint per forward pass.
blocks.zh: (二) 土著-多级(SAM3 + ): 为了让本地的SAM3架构适应传统的多类设置,我们按照分类维度对独立生成的对数进行压缩。 然后将标准软max \ matht{softmax} 激活用于明确校准整个N类的概率,然后通过交叉交替丢失和骰子丢失来优化. 为了防止因同时处理过多的类别而导致的记忆外错误,我们在培训期间采用了动态的即时取样策略:我们抽样目前场景中的所有地面真实类别,同时抽取数量变化不定的负面类别,确保每个前进通道都有稳定的内存足迹。

blocks.en: In the component ablation study presented in Table 2 , we evaluated a hard-coding background strategy as a comparative baseline against our proposed dynamic background token ( 𝒯 b ​ g \mathcal{T}_{bg} ). To implement this strategy without extensive manual annotation, we employed large language models (LLMs) to automatically generate a comprehensive, dataset-specific list of negative concepts ( e.g. , “sky”, “road”, and “cloud”) that frequently appear in scenes but belong to the background class. Specifically, we utilized GPT-5 [ 5 ] to generate K K diverse background concepts tailored to the domain of each benchmark. To prevent excessive semantic overlap with existing foreground categories, we applied the filtering pipeline of previous work [ 59 ] to these background concepts. First, we discarded visually uninformative and abstract concepts, such as “image” and “view”. Subsequently, we used the CLIP [ 45 ] model to compute the semantic similarity between the generated background concepts and the predefined foreground categories. Any background concept exhibiting a similarity score exceeding a threshold of 0.8 was removed. The specific prompts used are detailed below:

blocks.en: B.1 Further Experimental Analysis
blocks.zh: B.1 进一步实验分析

blocks.en: As observed in Table 1 , DCR-SAM achieves more pronounced performance gains on remote sensing benchmarks compared to natural scene benchmarks. We hypothesize that this phenomenon is fundamentally driven by the scale of the concept space: the massive number of fine-grained categories in natural scenes exacerbates feature space crowding and semantic competition. To validate this hypothesis, we conducted a progressive subsetting experiment on the highly complex ADE20K [ 70 ] dataset ( N = 150 N=150 ). Specifically, we establish a base set comprising the Top-30 most frequent categories and progressively expand the target category count N ∈ { 30 , 60 , 90 , 150 } N\in\{30,60,90,150\} . For subsets where N < 150 N<150 , all pixels belonging to unselected categories are uniformly absorbed by our dynamic background token ( 𝒯 b ​ g \mathcal{T}_{bg} ). Crucially, we isolate and track the performance of the identical Base-30 classes across all experimental configurations.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,与自然场景基准相比,DCR-SAM在遥感基准方面取得更显著的绩效收益。 我们假设这一现象从根本上是由概念空间的规模驱动的:自然场景中大量精细的分类加剧了特征空间拥挤和语义竞争. 为了验证这一假说,我们对高度复杂的ADE20K[70]数据集(N=150N=150)进行了渐进子设定实验. 具体来说,我们建立了一个由TOP-30最常见类别组成的基数组,并逐步扩大目标类别计数N { 30, 60, 90, 150}N\in 30, 60, 90, 150}。 对于N < 150 N < 150 的子集,所有属于未选类别的像素都由我们动态背景符号(Tb g\mathcal{T}_{bg})统一吸收。 关键是,我们隔离并跟踪所有实验配置中相同的Base-30类的性能.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 6 , As the number of semantic categories increases ( 30 → 150 30\rightarrow 150 ), the overall performance declines due to the introduction of difficult long-tail classes. Furthermore, the isolated Base-30 class also suffers a substantial degradation, dropping from 79.4% to 70.3%. This indicates that even the most well-represented foundational categories are negatively impacted by the severe feature competition and representational crowding triggered by a larger concept space. Consequently, in remote sensing scenarios where the concept space is typically constrained ( e.g. , N ≤ 10 N\leq 10 ), the dense competitive head can establish highly stable and non-overlapping semantic anchors. This effectively unlocks the full discriminative potential of the model architecture, thereby yielding superior performance gains.
blocks.zh: 如表6所示,随着语义类数的增加(30~150 30\rightarrow 150),由于采用了困难的长尾类,总体性能下降. 此外,与世隔绝的Base-30阶层也经历了严重的退化,从79.4%下降到70.3%。 这表明,即使代表性最强的基本类别也因更大的概念空间引发的严重特征竞争和代表性拥挤而受到不利影响。 因此,在通常限制概念空间的遥感假设(例如N 10 N\leq 10)中,密集的竞争头可以建立高度稳定和非重叠的语义锚。 这有效地释放了模型架构的全部歧视性潜力,从而产生优异的绩效收益.

blocks.en: We further investigate the impact of the concept space scale on inference latency. Specifically, we evaluate the DCR-SAM framework on the ADE20K dataset with 150 categories ( A-150 ) alongside its full version comprising 847 categories ( A-847 ), as well as the PASCAL Context dataset with 59 categories ( PC-59 ) and its full version comprising 459 categories ( PC-459 ). As illustrated in Figure 9 , expanding the target categories from 150 to 847 on ADE20K introduces a manageable latency overhead of + 369 +369 ms (244 ms → \rightarrow 613 ms). Similarly, scaling from 59 to 459 categories on PASCAL Context incurs a mere + 217 +217 ms increase (199 ms → \rightarrow 416 ms). Compared to the staggering 8038 ms required by the native SAM3 on the A-150 benchmark (please see Table 2 ), these fractional increments are practically negligible. While our core cross-modal feature fusion process remains strictly category-agnostic, the lightweight matrix operations within the VCTR module and the dense competitive head naturally introduce a sub-linear computational overhead as the number of target concepts N N grows. Nevertheless, achieving high-fidelity semantic segmentation for nearly a thousand categories in approximately 600 ms thoroughly demonstrates the extreme efficiency and scalability of our architecture, effectively bypassing the severe 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(N) complexity bottleneck inherent to the native SAM3 baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步调查概念空间尺度对推断延迟的影响。 具体地说,我们评价了DCR-SAM关于ADE20K数据集的150个类别(A-150)及其包含847个类别的完整版本(A-847),以及包含59个类别的PASCAL背景数据集(PC-59)及其包含459个类别的完整版本(PC-459)。 如图9所示,将ADE20K上的目标类别从150个增加到847个,引入了可管理的延迟管理费,即+369+369 ms(244 ms ~\右旋613 ms)。 同样,将PASCAL上下文的59个类别扩大至459个类别,只增加+217+217毫秒(199毫秒=\右旋416毫秒)。 与当地SAM3在A-150基准(见表2)上要求的惊人的8038 ms相比,这些分数递增几乎可以忽略不计。 虽然我们的核心跨模式特性聚变过程仍然严格地是类别不可知的,但VCTR模块内的轻量级矩阵操作和密集的竞争头自然会随着目标概念NN数量的增加引入子线性计算间接费用. 尽管如此,在大约600ms中实现近千类高精度语义分解,充分显示了我们建筑的极高效率和可扩展性,有效地绕过了本地SAM3基线所固有的严重O ⁡(N)\mathcal{O}(N)复杂性瓶颈。

blocks.en: Our VGTP module employs Global Average Pooling (GAP) on the visual features 𝒱 ∗ \mathcal{V}^{*} to generate a global visual embedding 𝒱 g \mathcal{V}_{g} ( cf. Eq. 6 ). A reasonable concern is whether this GAP operation collapses fine-grained spatial cues, which are often deemed critical for resolving small objects in dense segmentation tasks. To investigate this, we conducted an ablation study comparing our GAP-based VGTP against a Spatial-Preserving Attention (SPA) [ 20 ] variant. Specifically, we bypassed the GAP operation and flattened the spatial dimensions, computing a dense similarity matrix 𝒮 \mathcal{S} directly between the aligned text sequence 𝒫 ~ ∈ ℝ N × l × d \tilde{\mathcal{P}}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times l\times d} and the full spatial visual features 𝒱 ∗ ∈ ℝ h ​ w × d \mathcal{V}^{*}\in\mathbb{R}^{hw\times d} . blocks.en: As presented in Table 7 , the incorporation of the full spatial resolution in the SPA variant elevates the computational complexity of the attention mechanism. This introduces a slight inference latency and a concurrent performance decline ( e.g. , a 4.8% mIoU drop on the ADE20K dataset). We argue that the retention of the full spatial resolution during the anchor generation phase compels the model to overfit to localized, noisy visual artifacts. In contrast, the GAP operation serves as an effective information bottleneck. It distills robust global representations from the features to reliably guide the aggregation of the text sequence, while delegating the high-fidelity spatial delineation to the final Dense Competitive Head.
blocks.zh: 如表7所示,将全空间分辨率纳入SPA变体提高了关注机制的计算复杂性。 这引入了轻微推论延迟和同时性能下降(例如,ADE20K数据集的mIoU下降4.8%). 我们主张,在锚地生成阶段保留完整的空间分辨率,迫使模型过于适合局部,吵闹的视觉文物. 与此相反,GAP行动是一个有效的信息瓶颈。 它从特征中提炼出强有力的全球表述,以可靠地指导文本序列的汇总,同时将高度真实性的空间划分委托给最后的Dense Contracted Head。

blocks.en: To thoroughly investigate the efficacy and potential limitations of the hard-coding strategy, we conducted an ablation study varying the number of generated background concepts, denoted as K K . Using the filtered background concepts (please see Appendix A.1 ), we reported the overall mIoU and inference time on the remote sensing benchmarks by progressively scaling the hard-coding concept number, i.e. , K ∈ { 10 , 20 , 30 , 40 , 50 } K\in\{10,20,30,40,50\} . During the inference phase, we appended these filtered concepts to the target category list to explicitly absorb non-target pixels. As shown in Figure 9 , due to the highly efficient, decoupled architecture of DCR-SAM, processing these additional concepts introduces only a marginal computational overhead rather than a severe latency bottleneck. However, the primary limitation emerges in the semantic performance, while scaling up K K initially improves background absorption, the performance gains rapidly saturate, even with a large set of explicitly designed negative concepts, the rigid textual anchors struggle to encompass all unconstrained background variations, resulting in suboptimal performance compared to our proposed dynamic background strategy ( 𝒯 b ​ g \mathcal{T}_{bg} ), which consistently achieves superior performance, demonstrating that it provides a more elegant and adaptable solution for robust semantic masking without the necessity of exhaustive prompt engineering.
blocks.zh: 为了彻底调查硬编码战略的功效和潜在局限性,我们进行了一项消化研究,研究产生了不同数量的背景概念,即KK。 利用经过过滤的背景概念(请见附录A.1),我们通过逐步缩放硬编码概念号,即K { 10、20、30、40、50}K\in 10、20、30、40、50}报告了mIoU的总体情况和遥感基准的推断时间。 在推论阶段,我们将这些过滤的概念附加到目标类别列表中,以明确吸收非目标像素. 如图9所示,由于DCR-SAM的高度高效,脱钩的架构,处理这些附加概念只引入了边际计算间接费用,而不是严重的延迟瓶颈. 然而,在语义性能方面出现了主要的限制,虽然扩大K K 最初改进了背景吸收,但性能迅速饱和,即使有一套明确设计的负面概念,僵硬的文字锚地也挣扎着包括所有不受约束的背景差异,因此与我们提议的动态背景战略(Tb g \mathcal{T}_{b}})相比,性能不尽理想,始终达到优异的性能,表明它为强健的语义面具提供了更优雅和适应性更强的解决方案,而无需详尽的即时工程.

blocks.en: To further evaluate inference efficiency, we compare DCR-SAM with native SAM 3 under different batch sizes on ADE20K, which contains 150 categories. As shown in Table 8 , increasing the batch size from 1 to 50 reduces the inference latency of SAM 3 from 8038 ms to 5687 ms per image, but increases memory consumption from 9010 MB to 29080 MB. In contrast, DCR-SAM achieves a substantially lower latency of 244 ms with only 6318 MB of memory.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价推论效率,我们将DCR-SAM与ADE20K上不同批量尺寸的原生SAM 3进行对比,后者包含150个类别. 如表8所示,把批量尺寸从1个增加到50个,将SAM 3的推论延迟度从8038 ms降低到每幅图像5687 ms,但将内存消耗量从9010 MB提高到29080 MB. 相比之下,DCR-SAM实现了244 ms的低得多的耐久性,只有6318 MB的内存.

blocks.en: The limited acceleration of batched inference stems from the architecture of SAM 3, which involves backbone inference, feature fusion, and mask decoding. Although batching reduces redundant backbone computations by sharing visual features across categories, feature fusion and mask decoding must still be performed separately for each category, resulting in increasing computational overhead as the number of categories grows. In contrast, DCR-SAM performs backbone inference and feature fusion only once, with negligible additional overhead from the lightweight matrix operations in the VCTR module. These results demonstrate the superior computational efficiency and memory utilization of DCR-SAM in large-scale multi-class segmentation.
blocks.zh: 分批推论的有限加速源于SAM 3的架构,它涉及骨干推论,特征聚变,以及面具解码. 虽然分批通过在类别之间共享视觉特征来减少冗余骨干计算,但特征聚变和遮罩解码仍必须针对每个类别单独进行,导致随着类别数量的增加而增加计算间接费用. 相比之下,DCR-SAM只进行一次骨干推论和特征聚变,从VCTR模块中的轻量级矩阵操作中可以忽略不计的额外间接费用. 这些结果表明,在大规模多级分解中,DCR-SAM的计算效率和内存利用率都比较优越.

blocks.en: To verify the effectiveness of our method in mitigating overlapping predictions, we conduct a visual analysis of the cross-modal activation maps. As illustrated in Figure 10 , it can be observed that directly aggregating the masks obtained from the independent inference of the native SAM3 results in overlapping predictions within the same regions. In contrast, our method effectively alleviates this issue through explicit inter-class competition.
